test_cases.title: Standard 7-day golden route (Tokyo-Kyoto-Osaka-Hiroshima) with Halal
test_cases.user_scenario:
Plan a 7-day Japan trip.

Arrival: 1 Oct 2026, 10:00 at Narita (NRT)
Departure: 7 Oct 2026, 18:00 at Kansai (KIX)
Dietary requirement: Halal
Pace: Moderate

Preferences:
Visit Tokyo (Asakusa and Shibuya), Kyoto (Kyoto Station and Gion),
Osaka (Dotonbori), and Hiroshima. Prefer Hikari and Sakura where possible.
test_cases.expected_pass_recommendation: JR Pass 7-day likely suitable

test_cases.title: Fast-paced itinerary with tight timing
test_cases.user_scenario:
Plan a 5-day fast-paced trip.

Departure: 20 Oct 2026, 10:00 at Kansai (KIX)
Dietary requirement: Vegan
Pace: Fast-paced

Preferences:
Visit as many cities as possible. Focus on major attractions only.
test_cases.expected_pass_recommendation: DO NOT BUY - 5-day Tokyo/Kyoto/Osaka route totals about 16,300 yen in tickets, far below the 50,000 yen 7-day pass. Timing is tight but that does not change the fare verdict.

test_cases.title: Extended trip (14 days)
test_cases.user_scenario:
Plan a 14-day trip.

Arrival: 1 Oct 2026, 12:00 at Narita (NRT)
Departure: 15 Oct 2026, 18:00 at Kansai (KIX)
Dietary requirement: Vegan
Pace: Relaxed

Preferences:
Visit Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Hiroshima, and other cities if recommended.
test_cases.expected_pass_recommendation: DO NOT BUY - a 14-day westbound NRT-KIX route totals about 39,600-41,300 yen against the 50,000 yen 7-day pass. CAVEAT: this is the least robust expectation in the set - a route that doubles back to Tokyo mid-trip reaches about 58,900 yen and would flip the correct answer to BUY. Re-check this case in Stage 7 if the generated route backtracks.
